To Whom It May Concern,  

I have collaborated closely with Ines Pereira over the past two years as a professor and mentor at a small FAANG company, where she served as a QA Test Engineer at VerveTech Consulting. Ines’ role required her to design and execute rigorous test strategies for high-stakes client projects, often under tight deadlines.  

Ines’ strength lies in her analytical rigor and ownership of complex test frameworks. She spearheaded the implementation of Selenium and Playwright for end-to-end testing, reducing regression cycle times by 40% in a critical healthcare platform project. Her ability to translate ambiguous client requirements into actionable test scenarios ensured alignment between development and quality goals. She also led the design of a test strategy for a distributed API system, which improved error detection rates by 30% during integration phases.  

A standout example of her impact occurred during a cloud migration project. Ines identified a critical gap in the test automation suite, rearchitecting it to incorporate GitLab CI pipelines. This change reduced deployment risks by 25% and streamlined cross-team collaboration. Her work ethic—relentless in debugging and proactive in mentoring junior engineers—made her an indispensable part of the team.  

Ines is a reliable collaborator who balances technical precision with creative problem-solving. Her contributions have consistently elevated team efficiency and product reliability.  

Please feel free to reach out for further details.
